title: Velocity Motors CTV win on GNN (Aug 2024)
text: Velocity Motors executed an always-on CTV prospecting initiative on Roku inventory from Global News Network. The flight emphasized upper-funnel reach with conservative frequency caps and household-level targeting in key DMAs. Creative featured a 15-second pre-roll highlighting financing offers and brand safety compliance for news inventory. Traders observed strong viewability and attention metrics during evening dayparts, while clearing CPMs remained stable despite rising floors. Notes from optimization: broaden geo list beyond tier-one DMAs and test sequential messaging to lift test-drive intent.

title: Velocity Motors CineMax delivery (Sep 2024)
text: Magnite supplied premium entertainment inventory on CineMax with mid-roll placements adjacent to long-form movies. Bid density was healthy and prices consistently cleared above exchange floors; competitive pressure increased on Friday prime time. The team pivoted to private marketplace deals to secure priority paths and reduce hop count, which modestly improved win rate and IVT profile. Completion rate exceeded benchmarks for 15s creative and incremental test-drive leads rose after call-to-action refresh. Recommendation: expand creative rotations and introduce dynamic end cards for localized dealers.

title: Velocity Motors SportsNow live sports (Nov 2024)
text: Xandr enabled access to live sports on SportsNow including weekend matches and highlight shows. Audience skewed male 25–54 with high co-viewing; attention and completion were elevated during live events compared with replays. Traders increased bid caps for marquee games which improved win rate without materially impacting eCPM. Brand suitability controls excluded alcohol-heavy content while retaining high-value sports segments. Post-campaign survey indicated double-digit lift in brand recall among in-market auto intenders.

title: Acme Retail Back-to-School awareness (Sep 2024)
text: Acme Retail launched a back-to-school awareness push with 30s creative on news and entertainment channels. Objective focused on broad reach and viewability; traders constrained frequency to prevent fatigue across Roku devices. Contextual segments targeted family and education content; brand safety maintained via standard and enhanced filters. Sequential messaging tested coupon overlays which increased site visitation from CTV QR scans. KPI summary: viewability above 90 percent, CTR modest by design, and incremental reach vs linear confirmed by identity graphs.

title: Acme Retail Holiday push (Dec 2024)
text: Holiday flights concentrated budget on high-impact placements with strong completion and incremental reach. Private marketplace packages secured premium home-screen and pre-roll inventory while maintaining strict brand-safety tiers. Demand spiked during the last shipping window, pushing floors higher; pacing safeguards redistributed spend to off-peak hours. Creative offered limited-time bundles with QR codes and store locator deep links. Post-flight analysis showed uplift in omnichannel sales where households were exposed both on CTV and mobile.

title: Streamio+ subscriber growth on FireTV (Jan 2025)
text: Streamio+ initiated a subscriber acquisition program targeting entertainment and live sports viewers on FireTV. Creative emphasized new originals, a seven-day free trial, and simple onboarding. Most conversions attributed last-click within a two-hour window, though a non-trivial share came from view-through within 48 hours. Supply-path optimization prioritized direct connections to reduce latency and improve render rate. Engineering flagged occasional device resets affecting measurement; compensated via modeled conversions using server-side signals.

title: Streamio+ steady subs (Mar 2025)
text: CineMax entertainment inventory on Roku delivered steady subscription volume at competitive eCPMs. Budget pacing tracked exactly to monthly targets, and CPA variance remained low across dayparts. Creative testing compared three end-card variants; localized price messaging improved conversion propensity among new households. Identity resolution leveraged household devices to prevent over-frequency on shared TVs. Next test: incrementality with ghost bids against the control geography.

title: Streamio+ view-through credit (Apr 2025)
text: Several conversions were credited on a view-through basis within 48 hours of exposure, consistent with subscription behavior for streaming services. Analysts validated the pattern by aligning exposure timestamps, server-side events, and campaign logs. Creative rotation tested new call-to-action phrasing, where the "Watch tonight" variant drove higher micro-conversions but similar final subs. Brand-safety remained stable; IVT rates stayed below internal thresholds. Recommendation: keep the view-through window at forty-eight hours and continue messaging experiments.

title: Velocity Motors spring push (May 2025)
text: Spring promotions highlighted low APR financing and new model launches. GNN news programming maintained broad household reach and contributed incremental test-drive leads in priority markets. Contextual targeting expanded into business and travel segments, with negligible impact on suitability. Creative frequency optimized to maintain awareness while controlling cost per site visit. Sales team reported better dealer foot traffic in regions with higher CTV penetration and linear under-delivery.

title: Streamio+ summer surge (Jul 2025)
text: The summer slate of marquee originals drove a sustained surge in subscriptions. Sports adjacencies continued to perform with high completion rates and favorable ROAS, particularly around tournament weeks. Pacing tools shifted spend into periods with the best predicted conversion propensity using model scores. Additional creative variants with talent cameos lifted attention but required rights clearance; legal approved limited rotation. Engineering notes: latency improvements on FireTV reduced drop-off in first quartile playback.
